# Humanoid fixtures

`VRMC_vrm.humanoid.humanBones.schema.json` is the official role/required-set
schema fetched 2026-09-25 from:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vrm-c/vrm-specification/master/specification/VRMC_vrm-1.0/schema/VRMC_vrm.humanoid.humanBones.schema.json

`legacy-cc4-body-profile.json` preserves the authored mapping portions of the
previous CC4 preset: all 17 roles, all AU bone bindings, composites, continuum
pairs, bone aliases and the three starter body controls. It represents an
existing persisted preset snapshot before full semantic skeleton coverage.
